name: Garlicky Spaghetti With Artichokes and Walnuts

ingredients.name: canned artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
Parmigiano-Reggiano, grated , plus extra for serving

instructions.primary_message: In a 25-cm skillet, combine garlic and oil and cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, until garlic is pale golden brown, 6 to 9 minutes. Off heat, stir in fennel seeds and pepper flakes until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Stir in artichokes; set aside.

In a pot or large sauté pan of salted boiling water, cook spaghetti, stirring frequently, until al dente. Reserve 1 cup cooking water, then drain pasta and return it to pot. Scrape reserved artichoke-garlic oil into pasta, then add cheese, nuts, lemon juice, and 1/2 cup reserved cooking water. Stir until pasta is well coated with oil and no water remains in bottom of pot, adjusting with more reserved cooking water as needed. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Transfer to serving dishes and sprinkle with parsley and extra cheese.

schema_metadata.keywords: spaghetti recipe, Garlicky Spaghetti With Artichokes and Walnuts

description: Jarred artichoke hearts, toasted garlic, and crunchy walnuts transform spaghetti into an elegant pantry pasta that's quick enough for weeknights but impressive enough for company.
notes:
Optional substitutions: canned artichoke hearts → jarred artichoke hearts

Make-ahead and storage: The pasta is best eaten immediately after cooking. Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Leah Colins
